explanation: Genotype refers to the specific combination of two alleles an individual possesses for a particular trait. If these alleles are identical, the genotype is homozygous; if they are different, the genotype is heterozygous. In contrast, phenotype refers to the physical appearance or observable characteristics of the individual resulting from their genotype.
